text: Cooking transforms basic components into superior food through skill. Garlic serves as the initial component for numerous recipes because it provides sharp and salty notes. Following this step, onions are added to temper that strength, producing a balanced taste that improves the final result. These items are prepared in various ways, including browning, heating slowly, or cutting finely, yet they remain essential across many cooking traditions ranging from pasta dishes to wok meals. Their inclusion consistently deepens the flavor and adds warmth to the plate.
